title: CRISC® Certification (Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control)
body: Information Systems Audit and Control Association (ISACA)
summary: The premier enterprise IT risk management credential covering 4 job practice domains: Governance, IT Risk Assessment, Risk Response and Reporting, and Information Technology and Security with 150 MCQs and 3 years experience.

standard.name: Standard CRISC Track
standard.blurb: Pass the 150-question examination (scaled score 450/800) and verify 3 years of professional IT risk and control experience.

stages.title: Stage 1: IT Risk Governance & Risk Assessment
stages.subtitle: Domain 1: Governance (26%) & Domain 2: IT Risk Assessment (20%)

nodes.name: Domain 1: Governance
nodes.description: Organizational strategy, risk appetite and tolerance, enterprise risk culture, policies and standards, business continuity, and three lines of defense.
topics: Organizational Governance Structures & Board Risk Oversight
Risk Appetite, Tolerance Limits & Key Risk Indicators (KRIs)
Enterprise Risk Culture, Ethics & Communication
Three Lines of Defense & Enterprise Risk Management Alignment

nodes.name: Domain 2: IT Risk Assessment
nodes.description: Risk identification, threat modeling, vulnerability analysis, business impact analysis (BIA), risk scenarios, and quantitative/qualitative risk analysis.
topics: IT Risk Identification & Emerging Technology Threats
Threat & Vulnerability Assessment Methodologies
Quantitative Risk Analysis (FAIR) vs Qualitative Risk Matrix
Risk Scenario Development & Enterprise Impact Modeling

stages.title: Stage 2: Risk Response, Reporting & IT Security Controls
stages.subtitle: Domain 3: Risk Response & Reporting (32%) & Domain 4: IT & Security (22%)

nodes.name: Domain 3: Risk Response and Reporting
nodes.description: Risk response options (avoidance, mitigation, sharing, acceptance), control design and implementation, control monitoring, and executive risk reporting.
topics: Risk Response Evaluation: Mitigation, Transfer, Acceptance, Avoidance
Control Design, Selection & Compensating Controls
Control Monitoring, Testing & Key Control Indicators (KCIs)
Executive Risk Dashboards, Heatmaps & Stakeholder Reporting

nodes.name: Domain 4: Information Technology and Security
nodes.description: Information technology principles, network architectures, data management, identity access management, cloud security, and cyber resilience.
topics: Enterprise IT Architecture, Network Topologies & Micro-Segmentation
Data Security, Cryptographic Controls & Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
Cloud Computing Governance (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) & Third-Party Controls
Resilience, Backup Architecture & Incident Handling Protocols

nodes.name: CRISC Computer-Based Examination
nodes.description: 150-question computer-based examination testing the 4 CRISC job practice domains. Passing standard: scaled score of 450 out of 800.

nodes.name: 3 Years Verified IT Risk & Control Experience
nodes.description: Document at least 3 years of cumulative professional work experience across at least two CRISC domains (with at least one year in Domain 1 or Domain 2).
topics: 3-Year IT Risk Experience Verification
Supervisory Validation

nodes.name: CRISC Credential Conferred & Annual CPE
nodes.description: Conferral of the CRISC designation. Maintenance requires at least 20 CPE hours annually (120 hours over a 3-year cycle) and payment of annual dues.
topics: CRISC Credential Award
Annual 20 CPE Requirement
Adherence to ISACA Code of Ethics
